why: importSave writes only keys on SAVE_KEYS. That is a security property, not tidiness: austinorphan.com's localStorage namespace is shared with every other project page on the origin (CLAUDE.md), so a blob a player was talked into pasting must not be able to set a neighbour's key. Dropping the allow-list leaves every round-trip test green -- the keys a real export carries are all on the list -- and is caught only by the case that imports a blob carrying a foreign key. Verified through this harness at the commit that added the entry. RE-POINTED in the #320 settings PR: the import allow-list is now `SAVE_IMPORT_KEYS` (SAVE_KEYS plus the legacy `tanks.touch.v1` compatibility key) rather than `SAVE_KEYS`, so the original find string no longer existed and the harness reported FAILED-TO-APPLY. The security property being mutated is identical -- the list is still an allow-list, and dropping it still lets a pasted blob set a neighbour's key.
killedBy: importSave never writes a key outside the allow-list
